bio: Tyxil will tell you he was chased out of the Emerald Kingdom for being a radical. For sticking it to the man. Sneaking into the houses of nobles as a giant snake and stealing all their stuff certainly is radical, but it doesn't exactly make you many comrades. Tyxil now hides out in Freeport, trying to make ends meet as an assassin, a thief, a carnival act – anything will do, as long as it pays.
